decisions: Retain the intentional mismatch: item title is Lahvička lubrikantu, while full description calls the contents cukr. Do not replace the description with a technical explanation.

Maverick misinterprets the errand; Scarlett genuinely needed cooking sugar, later explains the shared joke, and will speak to Maverick herself. Keep her husband Peter as the shy referent, without confusing him with Maverick.
Quest name uses approved Cukr a koření; the later cukr/koření/něco pěkného euphemism remains consistent. The drug/lubricant identities, item/save keys and control pic tags stay exact.

The article-bearing item-caption value omits an English indefinite article in Czech. Its inflection and complete eventual received-item assembly remain part of the broader dynamic-producer case, which is not yet settled.
